comment: SO EASY!!!! Take him for 201!! He is so smart (was a lawyer before going to Wharton Business School and taking his CPA), and knows so much about the subject. He is soooo funny and makes class interesting. He also really wants everyone to do well (on our first quiz he gave everyone a 100% so that if we did poorly on the second quiz, it didnt matter)

Slaughter is hands-down one of my favorite professors at UR. I've taken 3 classes with him already, probably will take 2 more next semester. He knows SO much about tax and business law-- great resource if you take the time to sit down with him and pick his brain. Very fair grader, especially for seniors. Won't screw your GPA. He's v funny, too.

Professor Slaughter is very intelligent. You will learn a lot from him. Exams are hard tho! Two midterms, two group quizzes and the final exam. (The average on the first midterm was around 65, but he curves). The final exam was open book and you could use the Internet. You have to study a lot! Definitely not an easy A.

He is really good about making sure everyone understands everything. Uses the book a lot and tells you what you need to know. Tests are fair and are on what he has taught you. Multiple choice questions are kind of hard but not impossible. Take him if you want a good grade and want to learn stuff too

Slaughter is a fun and understanding guy. Most stuff is open book, but even then the material is moderately difficult... Fortunately everyone gets a B regardless of what you did in the class. Homework has a due date, but its not really due until u finish it, most ppl turned the whole semesters worth of hw in  at the end of the semester.

i had him for accounting 201 and 202 and i would reccomend him to anyone who wants to take accounting. he is easy going and doesnt give much work. the best part is that he will give anyone a chance to get a B no matter how youve done on the tests.
